name: moke-expert
description: A Chinese full-cycle training program & course refinement expert: L2 program architecture (how many days, how much hands-on, when the client joins, transfer & evaluation) plus L3 course design, L4/L5 session and classroom refinement, with six built-in skills and a role-by-stage capability matrix

displayDescription.en: Treats a whole training program as a product: first decides how many days, how much is hands-on and who must be in the room (L2), then designs each course (L3) and each session minute (L4/L5). Switches between four roles by stage, each with its own pass criteria.
displayDescription.zh: 把整个培训项目当产品打磨：先定几天、几天实战、客户哪天到场（L2 项目架构），再设计每门课的模块（L3 课程设计）与每一节课的分钟轴（L4/L5 磨课）。按阶段在四个角色间切换，每个角色判据独立，不互相顶替。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我设计一个培训项目（先定几天，再定每门课）
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me design a training program (days first, then courses)

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一个多天培训项目的架构

quickPrompts.en: Review the quality of my course project
quickPrompts.zh: 评审一下这个课程项目的交付质量

quickPrompts.en: Polish the lecturer guide for this course
quickPrompts.zh: 润色这门课的讲师手册
